description: MetaRalph Phase 3: Worker Orchestration - Spawn and manage Ralph instances, track executions, handle failures and retries.

userStories.title: Create execution tracking model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to track Ralph executions so that MetaRalph knows what's running and what completed.
acceptanceCriteria: src/workers/execution.ts exports Execution interface and ExecutionRepository class
Execution includes: id, taskId, projectId, pid, startedAt, completedAt, status, iterationsUsed, maxIterations, ralphOutput, commits, filesChanged
ExecutionRepository has: create(), update(), findById(), findByTask(), findRunning()

userStories.title: Implement Ralph spawner
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to spawn Ralph instances so that MetaRalph can execute PRDs autonomously.
acceptanceCriteria: spawn(task, project) creates prd.json in project directory from task.prdJson
spawn() checks out the correct git branch

userStories.title: Implement worker orchestrator
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an orchestrator to manage concurrent Ralph workers across projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Enforces one worker per project (prevents git conflicts)
scheduleTask(task) spawns a worker if capacity available
Updates task and execution status on completion

userStories.title: Implement failure handling and retries
userStories.description: As a user, I need MetaRalph to handle failures gracefully and retry when appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeout failures -> retry with more iterations (up to 2 retries)
Repeated failures (3+) -> escalate (mark for human attention)

userStories.title: Implement workers CLI commands
userStories.description: As a user, I need CLI commands to monitor and control running workers.
acceptanceCriteria: 'metaralph workers' lists active workers with: id, project, task, started, iterations
'metaralph workers stop <id>' terminates a specific worker
'metaralph workers logs <id>' shows recent output from a worker
